Compute edge of model probability over implied probability

Source: R/backtest_oagd.R
oagd_edge.Rd

Compute edge of model probability over implied probability

Usage

oagd_edge(model_prob, implied_prob)

Arguments

model_prob

Numeric. Model probability for an outcome.

implied_prob

Numeric. Devigged market implied probability.

Value

Numeric. Edge (positive = model sees value).
